verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show Siskind Susser documenting RFE or NOID response services for founder clients. The only RFE mention is a sample prompt for its Visalaw AI tool, which is aimed at immigration practitioners. A hypothetical prompt is not affirmative evidence that the firm handles RFE or NOID responses for clients. Its startup and O-1 practice pages cover initial visa strategy but say nothing about responding to evidence requests or intent-to-deny notices.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get help responding to an RFE or NOID — the provider documents request-for-evidence response work, not just clean first filings
